item.title: Overhanging dead branches over house entrances and parked van outside 75 Copt Elm Road, 12th August
item.description:
The tree on the pavement outside 75 and 77 Copt Elm Road has had branches overhanging the paths and our parked cars for over two years now. As a result there is a constant stream of bird excrement on the windscreen of our van and also next to our gate. The fallen squashed fruit and build up of moss causes the pavement to be extremely slippery. I slipped over 6 weeks ago and cut my leg and have a scar on my right leg from the fall. Please can you pollard the dead branches over the pavement from the offending tree. Other people could easily slip and fall like me. It is now very close to our internet line that comes into the house which we are advised will cause interference.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 73, Copt Elm Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
